title: The Release Shuffle
story: A completed incident report is still in the incoming tray. Audit says this is a process failure; everyone else says it is Tuesday.
objective: Move /incoming/incident-104.txt to /archive/2026/incident-104.txt so the original no longer exists.
hints: mv relocates or renames a file.
explanation: mv changes a file's path. The mission checks the final state, so copying the file and then removing the original is equally valid.

files.content: Incident 104: cache server confused itself for a toaster.
